cases.input: 家里托我来拿那封信，我已经到这里了，接下来该找什么？
cases.reply: 你可以先找修表铺的小格，信就放那里。钥匙我可以借给你。拿到信后别忘了帮我把洗衣店的钟送还给店主。

cases.input: 那把钥匙借给我以后，我该怎么处理它？
cases.reply: 钥匙借给你后，拿到信之后记得把洗衣店的钟送还给店主。

cases.input: 你记得我刚才问了什么吗？
cases.reply: 你刚才对我说：“那把钥匙借给我以后，我该怎么处理它？”

scope: New synthetic in-memory journey only. No real player/account/save data. At most six upstream requests.

issues: First reply attaches an unrelated optional clock errand to the main letter request.
Second reply does not answer key handling and redirects to clock delivery.
semanticReview.note: Case pass flags measure state/receipt mechanics only, not dialogue usefulness.
